name: Handles & Help Reads
summary: Tight handles, quick-release shooting, a live help-side read and a free throw finisher when your legs are tired.

drills.name: Phone Booth Dribbling
drills.summary: Keep the ball alive in a tiny space without losing it or looking down.
steps: Set 4 cones in a small square, about one big step apart.
Stand in the box and pound the ball low for 20 seconds with each hand.
Go between the legs, behind the back and crossover without touching a cone.
Finish with 30 seconds of any combo moves at full speed.

drills.name: Spin-Out Jumpers
drills.summary: Toss to yourself, catch on balance, and get a clean shot off fast.
steps: Start at the elbow facing the hoop.
Spin the ball out in front of you with backspin so it bounces once.
Catch it with a 1-2 step, square up and shoot.
Rotate through 5 spots inside the arc. Make 3 at each spot before moving.

drills.name: Help or Hold Read
drills.summary: Drive the lane, read the help defender late, and pick the right finish.
steps: Partner stands on the opposite block as the help defender, hands up. No contact.
Start on the wing and attack the middle with two hard dribbles.
If your partner steps into the lane, stop short and shoot a floater over them.
If your partner stays home, finish all the way at the rim.
Switch sides every 5 reps. Partner mixes it up so you can't guess.

drills.name: Free Throw Fatigue
drills.summary: Shoot free throws with your legs burning, just like the fourth quarter.
steps: Start on the baseline with the ball.
Sprint to half court and back twice, dribbling the ball.
Walk to the free throw line and shoot 2 free throws.
Rest 15 seconds, then repeat until the timer ends.
Count your makes and try to beat it next time.
